slices.title: Theme-authority
slices.summary: Defined explicit URL over host preference over dark fallback as one tested theme authority.

slices.title: Dark-defaults
slices.summary: Development animation surfaces now default dark through the shared theme authority; explicit light state still round trips.

slices.title: Neutral-foreground-parity
slices.summary: Neutral equation paint now aliases Catalogue prose ink through one theme-responsive token; no prose-font or motion change.

slices.title: Development-dock-theming
slices.summary: Development dock and review capture now follow active light/dark surface tokens with narrow-layout and production-erasure evidence.

slices.title: Theme-evidence
slices.summary: Captured and inspected seven deterministic theme states; the requested development theme tranche is complete.

slices.title: Planner-ID-collision-guard
slices.summary: Function-wrap and homomorphic low-level IDs now coalesce under one data-declared planner identity with collision guards.

slices.title: Planner-exposure-metadata
slices.summary: Every operation now declares canonical planner exposure or alias status; exposed operations carry required concise source-owned summaries.

slices.title: Alias-normalization-protocol
slices.summary: A data-derived alias registry now normalizes legacy/provider IDs to canonical planner IDs and rejects unknown IDs without renderer leakage or central switches.

slices.title: Canonical-prompt-projection
slices.summary: Planner prompts now contain only canonical exposed operation names and concise summaries; aliases remain preserved for backend compatibility but are not model choices.

slices.title: Validator-canonicalization
slices.summary: Validation now canonicalizes registered aliases, records verified requested-to-canonical provenance, round trips accepted records, and rejects unknown or forged normalization.

slices.title: Typed-unsupported-result
slices.summary: Unsupported transformations now produce a validated typed abstention with exact adjacency coverage and never enter compilation; malformed abstentions remain repair-required.

slices.title: Governed-source-resolver
slices.summary: Governed source selection now requires one exact source/revision and verifies operation, entity, assumption, and contract availability before specialized truth validation.

slices.title: Balanced-operation-binding
slices.summary: All six balanced operations now require exact source/revision, adjacency endpoints, ordered correspondences, role mappings, assumptions, and operation pins before compilation.
